question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No public national register of US stand-alone BESS in permitting was found; siting is decided by some state boards and by counties or cities. The October 2026 EIA-860M inventory (released 2026-11-24) reports 33 stand-alone battery plants of 1 MW or more with regulatory approvals pending (status L, 4,799.3 MW), a national proxy with coordinates, MW and entity but no permit dates. Its broader inventory has 250 stand-alone plants across all planned statuses, including projects before approvals, already approved or in construction. State boards (CA, WA, MA, CT, MN) and county or city records (Gillespie County and Baytown, Texas) provide administrative stages and dates.
main_caveats: The September 2026 EIA-860M approvals-pending subset (L) omitted 4 of 5 CA Opt-In BESS under review, WA Goldeneye and MA EFSB 26-01/26-02. Compare EIA and local dockets by scope and dated snapshot.
EIA-860M has no stand-alone flag: exclude Plant IDs with any non-battery generator in the Planned or Operating sheet. Interconnection queues (ERCOT GIS, LBNL) show grid study status, not permits.
Statuses can disagree: CA CEC shows Potentia-Viridi (400 MW) as 'Compliance - Pre-Construction' while EIA-860M October 2026 lists it as '(U) Under construction'.

Cross-source matching is weak: project LLC names differ from developers and MW can differ (CA Vaca Dixon 157 MW vs EIA 'Vaca BESS' 59.5 MW, 0.33 km apart). Match on coordinates or county plus name; flag doubtful matches.
In Texas, checked stage evidence came only from county and city records (Gillespie County, Baytown); Fort Bend County, ERCOT and the PUCT rejected automated requests.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA counts were reproduced on two editions and every state page and Texas record was reopened in this pass. Coverage is a sample (about 10 states, 3 Texas local bodies); doubtful matches are flagged.

attributes.gap_note: No national permitting list exists in the pages checked. About 40 state processes and most county and municipal records were not checked; EIA omits many early state and local cases.

attributes.gap_note: EIA publishes no permit dates. Dates exist only in scattered state and local records; most counties and about 40 states were not checked.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL -o oct2026.xlsx https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/october_generator2026.xlsx  # then read sheets 'Planned' and 'Operating' (header row 3: 'Entity ID', 'Entity Name', 'Plant ID', ...)
how_to_use.example_result: Planned sheet 'Inventory of Planned Generators as of October 2026': 2,325 generators; 481 Batteries (64,666.8 MW); stand-alone 257 generators / 250 plants / 31,853.6 MW. Row: Rock Rose Energy Storage LLC | 67249 Rock Rose Energy Storage | TX | Fort Bend | 200 MW | (U) | 3/2027 | 29.395241, -95.73535.
steps: Open the landing page and take the newest <month>_generator<year>.xlsx under /xls/ (older editions are under /archive/xls/; placeholder links for future months redirect to an error).
Read the 'Planned' and 'Operating' sheets; the header is Excel row 3 and note lines follow the data; keep rows whose Plant ID is numeric.
Collect Plant IDs that have any generator with Technology other than 'Batteries' in either sheet.
Keep Planned rows with Technology 'Batteries' whose Plant ID is not in that set: these are stand-alone battery plants. Group by Plant ID and Status.
To reproduce the pass-1 figure, also keep only Status starting '(L)': September 2026 = 85 battery rows with (L), 34 stand-alone plants (5,099.3 MW); October 2026 = 80 and 33 plants (4,799.3 MW).
October 2026 stand-alone plants by status: P 57 (10,233.7 MW), L 33 (4,799.3), T 21 (2,657.4), U 68 (6,878.1), V 46 (4,842.9), TS 25 (2,442.2). Texas has 105 stand-alone generators (17,483.3 MW).
reading_traps: Status is self-reported and coarse; '(P) ... regulatory approvals not initiated' rows are planned but not yet in permitting, so decide whether to include them.
Status can contradict the permitting authority: Potentia Viridi BESS is '(U) Under construction' in October 2026 while the CA CEC page shows 'Compliance - Pre-Construction'.
Between editions plants change status (Pinopolis BESS, SC, 300 MW moved from (L) in September to (U) in October 2026); compare editions by Plant ID, not by row order.
Name collisions: 'Peregrine BESS 1/2' (RWE, Goliad County, Canceled or Postponed sheet) is unrelated to Peregrine Energy Solutions' Rogers Draw BESS in Gillespie County.
The Planned sheet has no MWh field; the Operating sheet has 'Nameplate Energy Capacity (MWh)'.

problems: No permitting stage detail or permit dates.
Edition URLs move from /xls/ to /archive/xls/ after the next release; the old /xls/ address redirects to an error page.

if_unstructured.summary: Stages and dates sit in state docket systems (CA, MN, CT, WA, MA) and in county or city records (Texas examples). Each needs page-by-page reading; EIA gives coordinates for cross-checks.
recipe: List candidates nationally from EIA-860M (stand-alone filter, all planned statuses) and, for state-route states, from the CA REST layer and the MN, WA, MA and CT pages.
For each state docket, open the project page and take applicant, MW, location and the dated document that supports the current stage.
For Texas and other local-permit states, search county and city pages for BESS permit posts, enforcement notices and abatement agreements; record the document date and address.
Cross-match local and state cases to EIA by coordinates (CA: within 0.5 km), county and name; to ERCOT GIS by project name or INR. Record unmatched and doubtful matches separately.
Keep EIA status and the authority's stage side by side when they disagree (e.g. Potentia-Viridi).

open_questions: Potentia-Viridi (CA, 400 MW): the CEC page says 'Compliance - Pre-Construction' while EIA-860M October 2026 says '(U) Under construction'; only the authority or the owner can settle which is current.

Vaca Dixon (CA): CEC docket 26-OPT-01 states 157 MW, while EIA plant 69541 'Vaca BESS' (entity Vaca Dixon BESS LLC, 0.33 km away) states 59.5 MW; it is unclear whether they are the same project or phases.

history.note: No national BESS permitting registry exists; EIA-860M Status (L) lists 34 stand-alone projects without permit stages/dates, while sampled state siting portals cover subsets with real stages/dates.

Reproduced the EIA approvals-pending filter (34 plants in September, 33 in October) and counted all 250 plants across planned statuses separately. Added Texas local records, MN PUC dockets and the CT petition filed after the first review.

local_terms.term: Special Use Permit (SUP) / Conditional Use Permit (CUP)
local_terms.meaning: City or county land-use approval for a BESS site (e.g. Baytown, Texas).
Minnesota PUC permit required for storage of 10 MW or more.
Optional California Energy Commission route for storage of 200 MWh or more.
Connecticut Siting Council route used for small BESS (e.g. Petition 1728).

local_terms.term: Certificate of Environmental Impact and Public Interest
local_terms.meaning: Massachusetts EFSB certificate sought by BESS applicants.

local_terms.term: Stop work order / Notice of Violation
local_terms.meaning: County enforcement record (fire marshal, floodplain administrator) that dates a BESS stage in Texas.

local_terms.term: Reinvestment zone / tax abatement agreement (Tax Code ch. 312)
local_terms.meaning: Texas county or city record that names a BESS project and its site.

local_terms.term: Status codes P, L, T, U, V, TS
local_terms.meaning: EIA-860/860M planned-unit stages from approvals not initiated to construction complete.
